subject: Offer approval request — staff inference candidate (Anita Shah) comp exception

Subject: Comp proposal for Staff Inference candidate — Anita Shah

Hi Vivek —

Quick background: Anita Shah (ex-NLPFoundry) completed loop last week. Strong systems + production inference experience (latency-focused quant/ops). Hiring panel recommends a Staff-level (IC5) hire to lead inference architecture for core serving runtime.

Attached: candidate resume and my preliminary comp worksheet. Candidate communicated a competing offer in the $220k–240k base range with strong equity. We believe to close we should propose: base $250,000, sign-on $25k, equity 0.35% (4-year vest, 1-year cliff). That exceeds the market midpoint for our Staff band and requires a one-level / comp exception to IC5 with approval.

Can you confirm you want me to route an exception request to Comp & People Ops (cc'd Lauren)? If yes I will include market comps and manager justification.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Comp proposal for Staff Inference candidate — Anita Shah

Jasmine —

Thanks for the write-up. Short answers: yes, pursue an exception. Anita's system-level experience and prior results shipping serving runtime performance wins make this hire strategic — she would own cross-team inference reliability and compiler-driven kernel tradeoffs.

Manager justification (for the thread):
- Candidate led a GPU-kernel optimization project at NLPFoundry that reduced p99 latency by ~25% for 2B models.
- Strong track record taking models from research -> production with quantization and KV-cache optimizations.
- Will mentor our mid-senior engineers and lead the inference architecture roadmap.

Proposed comp: base $250k, annual target (OTC) $310k, sign-on $25k, equity 0.35%. If Comp needs banding guidance, I'm comfortable with making this an IC5 / Staff role rather than Senior.

Please route to Comp & Marissa for formal approval. Karthik — I looped you for technical fit confirmation if needed.

-Vivek
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Vivek / Jasmine —

I pulled recent market comp data (attached). Short summary: Staff inference/ML infra hires in the SF market are trending $230–265k base with top-of-market cases at $280k for rare compiler/ops combos. Equity median at ~0.25% — 0.4% for marquee hires. Given candidate's competing offer and specialized kernel/latency background, the proposed package is defensible.

Hiring checklist status:
- References: 2/3 complete (positive).
- Background check: pending candidate sign-off.
- Role leveling: Manager recommends IC5 (Staff) and expects leadership span across runtime teams.

I've attached market-comps-jan2026.pdf. I will prepare the formal exception request to People Ops with this packet.

Cheers,

Thanks for the packet. Two asks before I can sign off:
1) Please include a succinct one-paragraph business impact statement (how this hire materially moves the product/KPIs in next 12 months).
2) Confirm fallback offer (if candidate pushes above request): max base we will consider without exec waiver.

If both items are provided I can greenlight a comp exception up to the proposed numbers OR escalate to Rishi for final approval if an exec waiver is required.
